name: infinite-scroll
title: Infinite Scroll
description: Lays out any components as a list, responsive grid or masonry and calls onLoadMore as the end scrolls into view. Takes items with renderItem or composed children; scrolls the page or its own container, loads upward for chat history, or waits for a Load more button. useInfiniteList turns a page fetcher into its props, with loading, error and retry.
